exact_predecessor_frontier: Test exactly one adjacent ordering-sensitive parent aggregation case with two already-durable child completion identities C1 and C2 where the parent derives an ordered aggregate from canonical child-key order rather than arrival order; verify either arrival order reconstructs the same aggregate with no duplicate child identity.
planned_atomic_boundary: Compare two traces containing the same durable identities {C1,C2} in opposite arrival orders. Reconstruct parent input by deduplicating identity then sorting by canonical child key before aggregation. Pass only if both traces yield identical ordered aggregate [C1,C2] and cardinality 2.
tested_scope_guard: No concurrent writers, parent processed-state mutation, torn writes, more than two child completions, external side effects, or second semantic leaf.
exact_continuation_on_preflight_only: Execute the planned two-trace canonical-key reconstruction probe, persist exact-scope result and immutable receipt, update LATEST by CAS/readback, then return recurring-open.
